description: six separate camp objects: a canvas tent, a campfire with logs and stones, a stack of wooden crates, three wooden barrels, a small wooden cart, a pile of grain sacks for a top-down 3/4 view fantasy action RPG, seen from above at an angle, soft shading lit from the upper left, a thin dark outline, rich natural colours, detailed modern pixel art; arranged in a 3 by 2 grid with wide empty space between them, every object whole, not touching the others or the picture edges; on a plain flat pure white background
